study_identification_part.si4_title: Linking Personalized Brain Atrophy to Schizophrenia Network and Treatment Response

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Establish vertex-wise normative reference ranges for cortical thickness using healthy controls, compute patient-specific deviation (atrophy) maps in schizophrenia, derive personalized atrophy networks from healthy rs-fMRI, and test whether these networks relate to rTMS treatment outcomes.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Two-way ANOVA (Time×Group) on PANSS; post hoc within-group changes; Pearson correlation between rTMS-target connectivity (from personalized atrophy networks) and PANSS improvement; covariate-controlled correlation (age, gender, education, HAMA, HAMD, disease duration).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Active rTMS improved PANSS; target connectivity within personalized atrophy networks predicted symptom improvement in active but not sham group.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Significant Time×Group interaction on PANSS (F(1,50)=18.47, P<.0001). Active rTMS reduced PANSS (73.4±18.34 to 57.7±13.39, P<.0001); sham not significant (71.4±16.98 to 68.8±21.01, P=.40). Connectivity strength between rTMS target and personalized atrophy network correlated with PANSS improvement in active group (r=0.54, P=.005), not sham (r=0.25, P=.24); remained significant controlling for age, gender, education, HAMA, HAMD, disease duration (r=0.56, P=.01).

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Normative modeling based on single-center data; generalizability may be limited.
caa10_key_limitations.supporting_text: "the normative modeling was established using data from a single center, and this may not be generalized to other centers."

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Personalized atrophy networks derived from normative CT deviations can inform rTMS target connectivity; potential for patient-specific target selection.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: rs-fMRI available for 652/797 healthy controls used solely to compute atrophy networks; normative model built on CT with age/gender covariates; atrophy loci reported at W≥2 and W≥2.5; single-center cohort (Hefei, China).
